selection: Session 1 stratified 80/20 holdout by split_seed 42; select minimum validation-loss epoch among 500, then fresh full-Session-1 retraining
evaluation: One Session-2 evaluation per subject-seed after source-only selection
primary_comparison: subject-macro accuracy of author-leaning recipe minus existing local matched ATCNet recipe, paired by subject and seed
secondary_comparison: author-leaning ATCNet versus existing NPFEEGNet-RD on the same 54 subjects and 3 seeds
inference: average seeds within subject; 100000 subject bootstrap resamples and exact sign flips if computationally feasible, otherwise 200000 Monte Carlo sign flips with fixed seed 20260924; exploratory post-confirmatory
boundary: Existing OpenBMI PyTorch architecture port and data retained; author-leaning optimizer, batch size and 500-epoch schedule; not a framework-exact original-author reproduction.
